en:
Y'can't blame me fer all
yer guys gettin' hit.
Nothin' personal, yeah?

I'm gon' smash yer goddamn face in.
Watch close, y'lousy rat!
Dieee!
Looks like my grip's going too.

You can't blame me for
where my bat ended up.
That so?
Shall we get going, Matsunaga-aniki?
Shit, this ain't good...
I'm done playin' with ya.
C'mon! It's time fer a whuppin'!
No, he should be fine for now.

Hey, Nagumo.
Jus' the fella I needed.

But y'know, that was
only the first round.

I've already spent too long
messing around with you.

If you want to fight, you'll
have to find someone else.
I'm done waitin' on yer sorry ass!
Please, I'll pay what I owe.

It's okay. You shouldn't get involved.
This isn't your problem.
I can't, Kiyo-chan.
I ain't gonna take that.
If I did, well...

I wouldn't be able t'look ya
in the eye again.
What is this shit, Nagumo!?
Y'tryin' to disgrace my family? Huh!?
Patriarch Masuzoe...

We got our own way of doin' stuff.
Don't take this out on her, I'm beggin' ya.
Yer that in love with her, huh?

I see. Well if that's what y'wanna do,
y'better be ready fer the consequences!

Apologies fer causin' a scene.
I'll make sure t'buy a drink next time.
I'm real sorry 'bout this, Kiyo-chan.
Nagumo!

Get yer ass over here! Ain't y'gonna
show us what bein' a man's about!?
So sorry, Haruto-kun.
That was scary, huh?

I'll be back.
Just need a little air.
Kiryu-aniki!

I know I don't deserve this,
but please lemme call you aniki!
Hey, wait a second!
Nope!
I'll follow ya t'the ends o' the earth, Aniki!
Please, just accept me!
Let go.

I ain't lettin' go!
C'mon, Kiryu-aniki!

I'll do whatever y'say.
I'll swear an oath!

Er, forget the oath if y'want.
All I need is t'call ya my aniki!
I'm beggin' ya, Aniki!

Aniki, just lemme have this.
It's life n' death to me now.

My chance with Kiyo-chan's gone
fer good... Can't y'see it from my view!?
Do what you want.
Aniki!
Hirose-san, 'scuse me.

Y'snuck outta the hospital again?
You sure 'bout this?

It's fine.
The doctor's in on the whole thing.

Listen. I tell them I was in a car wreck,
and the insurance money starts pourin' in.

Not even a scratch on me, but they'll still
pay me jus' to sleep at the hospital.
This is Hirose-san, our patriarch.

Back when the Omi tried t'muscle in,
he was on the frontline, lobbin' grenades.
Ain't that right, Hirose-san?
Well, that was years ago.
Hey, Nagumo.
Don't stop there, y'idiot!

U-Uh, well... Lemme tell ya
about our guest here first.

This is Kiryu-san,
all the way from Tokyo.

He's gonna be comin' 'round our place,
so try n' be nice t'him, please.
Your turn, Aniki.

The name's Kazuma Kiryu.
It's an honor to meet you.

Y'don't need to be so formal here.
We're pretty laid back, for yakuza.

Must seem strange to a
Tokyo yakuza like you, though.

Well, actually...
I'm a civilian.
Really? That so?
Coulda fooled me, right?

Can't say I blame ya for thinkin he's yakuza.
Aniki here's tough as they come, boss.
By the way, Nagumo...

What'd ya do about that payment?
We're flat broke, right?

Did the big boys give
you any lip about it?

I've got a handle on that,
so nothin' t'worry about, boss.
Oh yeah? Works for me.

Hey Yuta, is the Cap here?
Captain!
I should probly check on that.
Y'can come too.
All right.

I gotta say, yer face is nothin'
t'write home about.
Don't touch me.
Yer tits ain't half bad, though.
Please, stop!
Don't y'think?
I'm really not comfortable...
C'mon, let 'em breathe a little.

Y'little punks. What're y'thinkin',
hittin' one o' yer customers? Huh!?

Y'can't get away with shit like that.
I'm gonna break every last one o' ya!
Shut up! Don't you know when to stop!?
That's enough o' yer lip!
Hey, who're you?
Can't y'see we're busy here?
Jus' get lost already.
Hm? HMM?
Huh? And who're you?
A customer, same as you.

I was hoping to relax here tonight. I'd like
it if you showed that woman some respect.
Old man. Y'from around here?

Y'don't know shit about
how this stuff goes.
Now what were y'sayin' about us? Huh!?
It's him again!
Wait, that's the guy Cap was callin' his aniki.

Y'hear that? This guy thinks he can
teach us some manners.

Before that, let us show ya how
things really work 'round these parts.

Go.
I'll be fine.
All right. Let's get 'im!
Owowwowow!
This is Haruto's mom.

Apparently the picture was taken
over in the bar district.
W-Wait, she's...
You know her?
Hey Cap, let me see!
Ah!

Sh-She's, uh... She's a lot younger
than I was expectin', that's all.
Looks almost like a high schooler, huh?
Right guys?
Huh? O-Oh yeah, totally.
But fer real, we've never seen her before.

None of us'd forget a girl
this pretty showin' up here.

Her name is Haruka Sawamura. She used
to be an idol, and she was on TV a lot.

O-Ohhh!
Makes sense she'd be so cute, then!

You're sure you haven't
seen her before?

Oh, right! I nearly forgot about
that errand the boss gave me.
Sorry, I gotta get goin'.
Hold up, what'd he ask ya t'do?

Shoot, it slipped my mind again.
I'll have to remember while I'm walkin'.

Matsunaga-aniki. We've gotta go clean up
at Moreno, right? C'mon, shall we?
Hm? Oh, I 'member now.

Well, sorry 'bout this.
We're gonna have t'go, too.
Matsunaga-aniki, c'mon.

Well, y'know how it is.
Lots'a busy work in a small family.
Sure seems that way.
And is your patriarch here today?
The boss?

Not sure, t'be honest.
He sneaks out the back all the time.
Lemme go look fer him.

No, it's all right. Just thought
I'd say hello before I head home.

I have reason to believe
the Hirose Family knew Haruka.

At least, that's how it seemed
when I showed them her picture.

But for some reason,
they chose to keep me in the dark.

Haruka-chan used to be an idol, didn't she?
Maybe that's how they know her.

No. If that were it, they could
have just come out and said so.

They were definitely involved with
Haruka somehow while she was here.

I can't really talk,
but they're pretty bad liars.

If they're going to lie,
they should learn to act.

But you know, I'm not angry.
And I don't plan on forcing it out of them.

I'll wait until they're ready
to tell me themselves.
And you're okay with that, Kiryu-san?
I actually kind of like them.
I'm heading over to Moreno now.
You mean the Hirose bar?

Yeah, the one run by that Matsunaga guy.
They're probably over there now.
I don't mean to impose...

...But could you look after Haruto again?
I'd rather not run into Masuzoe with him.

I'm happy to do that whenever you need it.
Haruto-kun is always welcome with me.
I'll bring him back to your place tonight.
Well, I'll see you tonight.
What the...
Kiryu-aniki?

What're ya doin'!? Stay back!
Y'can't do this!

I'm the head o' the Masuzoe Family!
The Yomei Alliance fights for me!

If y'kill me, every last yakuza
in Hiroshima'll be out for blood!
Quiet now, Masuzoe.
The Yomei Alliance fights for you, huh?

Y'think you're that important?
Fuckin' idiot.

You must be Kiryu.
Nice to meet ya.
And you are?

Yomei Alliance captain and patriarch of
my own family. The name's Koshimizu.

So, you're the number two
man in Hiroshima?

N-No way. Was this Kiryu-san?
He beat all these guys himself...?
Holy shit...

Y'think you're doing a good job
of hiding your identity...

...But to me, the dragon on yer
back is plain as day.
You know who Kiryu-san is, don't ya?

Even fer Hiroshima, this town's tiny.
Shipbuilding's all it's got goin'.
That said...

With you here, this little dump
just got a lot more interesting.

Wh-Whaddya mean by that?
Jus' who the hell <font_kind=yakuza_italic>is</font_kind> this guy?

The Hirose Family has
already been dealt with.
Consider it my warm welcome.
Kazuma Kiryu-san.

Cap'n Koshimizu was talkin' crazy, right?
That stuff 'bout yer identity...
Why'd y'come?

Didn't I tell ya not to leave Moreno!?
Why couldn't y'just stay put?

Y'think this is gonna solve anythin'?
Now the main family's got your scent.
Who knows what's comin' now?

I'd rather have lost my pinky n' been
done with it! Y'don't get this shit!
Trust me.
I know what I'm doing.
Ya goddamn turkey!

Listen up. If y'got time to criticize
Kiryu-aniki, y'got time to bow.

It's 'cause of him y'still got
all yer digits. Right!?

Matsunaga-aniki.
Y'didn't have t'cut yer finger off?
They really let you off the hook.
Wait, but...

Your face is all beat to hell!
They got ya good, huh?

Dammit... So the main family
really did punish ya?

Don't be an idiot.
I'm th'one who kicked Matsunaga's ass.

I-It was you, Cap?
Why'd y'do that?

Koshimizu was here. Matsunaga'd be
a finger short if I didn't do somethin'.

This whuppin' was all outta the
kindness o' my heart. Ain't that right?
U-Uh, right...
Good. Don't worry, Kiryu-aniki.

I made sure it looked
worse than it felt.

What're y'talkin' about!? That ain't true!
Y'damn near killed me!

It was jus' punch after punch
after punch, y'brute!

Y'got balls sayin' that,
ya ungrateful bastard!
C'mere!
Boss!?
When did ya get here?
I've been here the whole time.
Yer done fighting, right?
Nagumo. In that case...

...Do you know if Haruto's
dad is here in town?
I couldn't say fer sure.

Everyone loved Haruka-san,
but I never heard o' her datin' anyone.
And the baby's 'bout a year old, right?

Haruka-san musta got pregnant jus'
as she was shippin' out.
It was probly a year n' a half ago by now.

I haven't heard o' anyone who's
seen her since.

Even now, it's hard t'believe Haruto-kun's
really her kid. It jus' don't add up.
That's all me n' my family know.

Although, maybe I could point ya to
someone who knows more 'bout her.
Who?

Well, Haruka-san was workin' to support
herself here. At a bar over in town.
I'm sure ya know the place, Aniki.
Snack Kiyomi.

If anyone was close
to Haruka-san 'round here...
...It was Kiyo-chan.
Ahhhhhh!

Y'freakin' dumbbell!
Don't yell like that!
Yer gonna scare the baby!

But he already messed the diaper I just
gave him! Why won't he stop shitting!?

That jus' shows he's a healthy kid!
Now go on and get another one!
Hi there! Peekaboo!
This is hopeless!

A face like that ain't gonna stop
a baby from cryin', Cap.
What's that s'posed t'mean!?

Give it a rest already, would you!?
Just go away and let me deal with this!

'Scuse me!? Y'can't talk to yer captain
like that! I'll pulverize ya!

Well look at that.
Yer actually gettin' the hang of it.
Only cause y'make me do this so much.
Okay, all done! There we go!
Dammit... Why's he still crying?
Bring him here, Yuta.

Whoa. I guess he's jus' the calmest
when he's in yer arms, Aniki.
Maybe so.

Though if I had to guess, he'd probably
rather be with his mother instead.

So, do you know who
Haruto's father is?
I'm sorry. I don't.

It never seemed like Haruka-chan was
dating anyone when she worked at the bar.
I see...

I do have an idea, though.
I'm not totally sure, but...
You do? Who are you thinking?
Well<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
Heyyy!

This is the last place I expected to find you,
yet here you are, Kiryu-san.
Someya?
What are you doing here?
I could ask the same of you.

As for me, I've been staying
at that hotel right over there.

It's my first trip to the countryside.
Climbing all these hills is a real pain.
That's not what I'm asking.

I want to know why a Tojo Clan
patriarch is out here in Hiroshima.

Easy now, it's nothing you need
to put up your fists about.

I'm here to swear an oath. Between myself
and the Yomei Alliance's Koshimizu-san.

I already know what you're thinking.
Too much disparity in our ranks, right?

It's true. A mere family patriarch is no
equal to Hiroshima's number two man.

Under normal circumstances, the oath would
be between the chairmen, Dojima and Kurusu.

But as you know,
he's been indisposed with trials.
Even so, why would it be you here?
Excellent question, Fourth Chairman.

Acting Chairman Sugai is considering me
for the role of successor to the Tojo Clan.
You, a Tojo Clan chairman?

As Koshimizu is the Yomei Alliance successor,
we can swear this oath as complete equals.
I get the sense you don't approve.

Perhaps you're interested in coming back
to swear it in my place, Fourth Chairman?

I wouldn't object.
Fate seems to be pulling us together anyway.
Fate?

Our meeting all the way out here
is more than just coincidence.
And that woman beside you?
She used to be with me.
It's good to see you...
I should have known you'd come back here.

I looked everywhere for you after you left.
I must say, it's good to see you're safe.

Look at the time!
I should be getting back.
Well then, Fourth Chairman...
If you'll excuse us.

It's my first trip to the countryside.
I don't see the appeal, to be honest.
